about_short_description.short_description: ORO Labs, a Tokenized Gold Protocol on Solana.

product.name: $GOLD Token
product.description: A fully gold-backed digital token on Solana representing ownership of physical gold, enabling on-chain investment, trading, staking, and borrowing.

product.name: Staking Service for $GOLD
product.description: A service allowing users to stake their $GOLD tokens to earn 3-4% annual percentage yield paid in gold.

product.name: Borrowing Against $GOLD
product.description: A borrowing service that allows users to obtain liquidity by using their $GOLD tokens as collateral.

product.name: Gold Redemption Service
product.description: A service enabling users to redeem physical gold in increments as small as 1 gram through a partner network or home delivery.

product.name: Trading Interface for $GOLD
product.description: A technology platform interface enabling users to access third-party services for buying, selling, and trading $GOLD tokens.
